android.desc:
Do you have the desire, energy, skills and experience to be a startup founder? In this App you can register and then be contacted by startups that need a founder matching your profile.

Are you looking for a job and would like to work for a startup? In this App you can register and then be contacted by startups that need an employee matching your profile.

Are you looking for freelance work? In this App you can register and then be contacted by startups that need a freelance expert matching your profile.

Are you student looking for some unpaid work experience? In this App you can register and then be contacted by startups that need a beginner matching your studies.

Why spend lots of time searching for your next role when the startup companies can find you instead!

Help for technical problems can be requested by sending an email to support@initiumapps.com.

Help us improve this App by sending your feedback via email to support@initiumapps.com.

Terms of use:

1. All users must communicate in a respectful manner.
2. The App should be used solely for matchmaking between team members and startups.
3. Team members profile data must be as accurate as possible to ensure the best experience for everyone.
4. Text messages are short and will be deleted after 30 days. Detailed follow up discussions should be done via another dedicated messaging App.
5. Inactive team member accounts will be deleted after 12 months.
6. An email address can only be associated with one team member profile.
7. A LinkedIn URL can only be associated with one team member profile.
8. The Initium system will keep usage metrics to help track misuse.
9. The support email should only be used to request help from the Initium team, or to provide feedback on the App.
10. Misuse of the App can result in the user account being suspended.
11. Any subsequent agreements between team members and startups are not the responsibility of the App provider.
12. This App is suitable for people aged 21 years or older.

Disclaimer: This App stores only the data required for matchmaking. Sensitive information is encrypted to ensure privacy. Your private information will not be shared with other parties outside of the Initium ecosystem.
